A later frozen version (for example kx3 with the Tool tie-break) replaces this one only by a new pin: a reviewed edit of this file, after its own gate. The self-check texts are what the frozen build printed when it was registered (rl/results/strength_2026-10-05_kx3_exam/PREREGISTRATION.md); the digest belongs to that exact binary (selfcheck_measured_on_sha256), so a report on that binary records them instead of replaying the 12 games (kx3 both sides takes hours), and strength_prereg refuses them for any other binary. `slow_report.py --selfcheck` replays them and refuses on any difference. A REBUILD of the same source (for example on the cloud: rl/strength/build.sh <engine_ref> OUT prints the engine tree, the program sha256 and the harness source hash, which must be engine_tree and harness_source_sha256 below) is accepted only through `--program PATH`, which replays BOTH self-checks on that machine against the digests above. seed_reserved lists seed slots used by committed runs outside rl/results/slow_reports (the km3 smoke).
